name: hud_weather_fx_scalar_deleting_destructor
description: HudWeatherFx::ScalarDeletingDestructor runs the shared weather FX destructor, optionally deletes the object for flag bit 0, and returns the original this pointer.
known_limits: The class is now source-routed through zVideoFxPass3Element without a hand-authored FTable global; data coverage remains open for vtables/literals/strings, and tier S verification remains deferred.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4bde20 has no function/address warning tags and validates the thiscall scalar-deleting destructor contract: call HudWeatherFx::Destructor, call operator delete only when flag bit 0 is set, and return self.
Binary Ninja validates the thiscall scalar-deleting destructor contract; the source model relies on the C++ class hierarchy instead of recreating a HudWeatherFx FTable global.
The native scalar-deleting destructor smoke verifies no-delete and delete paths without table identity assertions.
